_source: Ported from the old project's NOTES.md. Canon, not invented.

town.name: Bellmire
town.inscription_over_the_chiefs_hall: MEASURE THE GRAIN. COUNT THE FLASKS. KEEP THE DOOR.

district_rules: Each district has a centre hex; its landmark is planted first, its own trades nearest that heart, then filler in its own character and density.
Hexes belong to the nearest district centre, which gives irregular organic borders rather than radial sectors.
Roof colour is the district signal. Only four liveries exist for eight districts, so they are assigned by ADJACENCY: no two neighbouring districts share one.

scar.name: wild-magic scarring
scar.rule: A botched casting scars the ground. Inside a scar, every spell misfires in turn.
scar.reading: The dungeon is one enormous scar. That is why a meadow sits under a mountain.
jests: the accident - trapped inside his own expanding mistake
the deliberate - a wound that makes more of itself is an engine that never needs winding
scar.handling: Keep both readings alive. Never resolve which one is true on screen.

canon_silences: No floor count is ever stated. The absence is canon: the dungeon is still being built.
